source.usage_note: Personal study only. Word pairs and explanations transcribed faithfully from the owner's reference; per-word senses are a mechanical split of the explanation, never rewritten.

senses.meaning: a farm producing milk or a milk product

entries.explanation: Dairy is a farm producing milk or a milk product. Diary is a daily written record.

senses.meaning: plural, referring to information or facts

entries.explanation: Datum is singular. Data is plural, referring to information or facts.

senses.meaning: the location and date notation in a news story
the date by which something must be completed

entries.explanation: Dateline is the location and date notation in a news story. Deadline is the date by which something must be completed.
Decent means socially acceptable or good. Descent means movement downward or ancestry.
Definite means certain or clear. Definitive means conclusive or final.

senses.meaning: to remove danger from a situation

entries.explanation: Defuse means to remove danger from a situation. Diffuse means to spread out or scatter.

senses.meaning: to decrease in value or to belittle
to express disapproval or to protest

entries.explanation: Depreciate means to decrease in value or to belittle. Deprecate means to express disapproval or to protest.

senses.meaning: a sweet course at the end of a meal
a dry region or to abandon someone

entries.explanation: Dessert is a sweet course at the end of a meal. Desert is a dry region or to abandon someone.

senses.meaning: a noun meaning a gadget or tool
a verb meaning to invent or plan

entries.explanation: Device is a noun meaning a gadget or tool. Devise is a verb meaning to invent or plan.

senses.meaning: Preferred usage is "different from," though "different than" is common in American English.
Preferred usage is "different from," though "different than" is common in American English.

entries.explanation: Preferred usage is "different from," though "different than" is common in American English.

senses.meaning: a choice between two undesirable options

entries.explanation: Dilemma is a choice between two undesirable options. Difficulty is any problem or challenge.

senses.meaning: to pay out or distribute money

entries.explanation: Disburse means to pay out or distribute money. Disperse means to scatter or spread out.
Discreet means respectful, prudent, or unobtrusive. Discrete means separate or distinct.
Disinterested means impartial or unbiased. Uninterested means not interested.
Don't have to means no obligation is required. Mustn't means something is forbidden.

senses.meaning: the bottom or lower side of something

entries.explanation: Downside is the disadvantage of a situation. Underside is the bottom or lower side of something.

senses.meaning: the first version of a document or to be enlisted
an air movement or a drink

entries.explanation: Draft is the first version of a document or to be enlisted. Draught is an air movement or a drink.

senses.meaning: to work hard at tedious tasks

entries.explanation: Dredge means to scoop up from water. Drudge means to work hard at tedious tasks. Trudge means to walk slowly and laboriously.
Dribble means to drool. Drivel means stupid or pointless talk.
Dual means having two parts. Duel is a fight between two people.

senses.meaning: a coloring substance or to color
to cease living or to stop working

entries.explanation: Dye is a coloring substance or to color. Die means to cease living or to stop working.
